title: Shine Sweep Button
summary: A diagonal highlight sweeps across the face on hover.
description: A skewed white gradient slides through the button on a single transform, the classic glossy hover in one pseudo-element.
accessibility_notes: Use a real <button>; keep a visible :focus-visible ring and never rely on hover alone to convey state. Motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
variations: Auto-sweep on a timer for a hero CTA
ai_usage: Any solid primary button that needs a little life. The sheen is a skewX(-20deg) gradient translated from -150% to 150%; keep overflow hidden and never animate left/right (use transform for compositing).
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Shine Sweep Button</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "shine-sweep-button",
    "title": "Shine Sweep Button",
    "summary": "A diagonal highlight sweeps across the face on hover.",
    "description": "A skewed white gradient slides through the button on a single transform, the classic glossy hover in one pseudo-element.",
    "theme": "buttons",
    "categories": ["button", "hover"],
    "tags": ["shine", "sweep", "gloss", "hover", "cta"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "beginner",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Use a real <button>; keep a visible :focus-visible ring and never rely on hover alone to convey state. Motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--c", "description": "Button color", "default": "#7c5cff" },
      { "name": "--dur", "description": "Sweep duration", "default": "0.6s" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Auto-sweep on a timer for a hero CTA", "Rainbow sheen", "Sweep in the opposite direction"],
    "ai_usage": "Any solid primary button that needs a little life. The sheen is a skewX(-20deg) gradient translated from -150% to 150%; keep overflow hidden and never animate left/right (use transform for compositing)."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: 0; }
    button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c5cff; outline-offset: 3px; }
    :root { --c: #7c5cff; --dur: .6s; }
    .shine { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: .95rem 2.2rem; border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--c); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; }
    .shine::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 60%; left: -80%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.45), transparent); transform: skewX(-20deg);
      transition: left var(--dur) ease; }
    .shine:hover::after { left: 120%; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="shine" type="button">Upgrade</button>
</body>
</html>
